independentReview.scope: Fail-safe inventory completeness, protected-warning classification, relocation requirements, exact Kotlin notice coverage, and regression/instrumentation evidence.
independentReview.limitations: SafetyWarningPresentationTest compiles, but connected-device execution remains pending because no Android target was attached.
independentReview.deletionAuthorization: No protected-warning deletion is authorized. Later B8/B9 work must preserve each retain/relocate decision and equal-or-greater prominence requirements.

decisionSemantics.retain: Keep the text/tag and its meaning at the current user-visible point of use.
decisionSemantics.relocate: Preserve the complete warning meaning at an equally prominent, contextual point of use; never silently delete it.
decisionSemantics.collapse: Combine non-protected or duplicated presentation without deleting any protected warning meaning.
decisionSemantics.remove: Remove only non-protected metadata from the user-visible safety presentation after independent review; underlying feature/filter data may remain.

inventoryMethod.canonicalContent: Exhaustive inventory of all 540 nonblank user-visible canonical content paths: title, summary, materials[], setupSteps[], playSteps[], parentNotes, variations[], promptText, followUps[], and Mad Libs field label/example plus template/readAloudNote. Every path receives an explicit semantic classification; this is not a regex or keyword scan.
inventoryMethod.runtimeContent: The exhaustive 540-path canonical inventory is checked against the paired runtime asset; regression tests require exact canonical/runtime text parity for every classified content entry.
inventoryMethod.safetyTags: Every enum member from content/kinplay-content.schema.json, including currently unused food_optional.
inventoryMethod.kotlinUi: Manual audit of user-visible and accessibility-visible safety, privacy, and platform-limit notices in app/src/main Kotlin.

reviewGate: No collapse/remove implementation is authorized by B1. Independent safety/spec review is required before B8/B9 UI or content implementation.
